name: Away Prompts
description: Gentle ideas for when you step away from your desk while agents work, one at a time, with a quiet clock for time away. Install a prompt pack to fill it.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: One gentle idea at a time for when you step away from your desk. The ideas come from a prompt pack.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Take an idea or leave it, and come back when you are ready.
howToPlay: Read the idea on the card.
Press Another idea to see a different one, or Previous idea to go back.
A quiet clock counts the time you have been away.
Press Back at desk when you return. Press Away again to keep counting.

controls.action: Previous or another idea, when the card is focused

tips: The clock only counts while this activity is open and running. It stops when Lullshift pauses it.
Ideas are only suggestions. Skip any that do not suit you.
